title: Cop had to fire fatal shot, investigators rule
article: A Toronto officer was "legally justified" in shooting a 63-year- old man last month during a confrontation with police resulting in the man's death, the province's Special Investigations Unit said yesterday.

Antonio Bellon was shot dead after police were called to a Toronto address on Jan. 10 to investigate a threatening complaint. Officers tried to speak to Bellon and followed him through a pathway near his home, said a release by the Special Investigations Unit.
It said Bellon fired at Sgt. Allen Jenkins, hitting him in the shoulder. Jenkins ordered Bellon to put the firearm down and, when Bellon didn't, fired three shots at him.
The unit said "there was only one course of action open to the officer."
